en.headline: Election Committee counting completes with results published after record turnout
en.dek: The Electoral Affairs Commission said counting finished at 10.15pm on Sunday; Chief Executive John Lee congratulated the winners.
body: The Electoral Affairs Commission said vote counting for the Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections finished at 10.15pm on Sunday. Polls had closed at 6pm, and counting at the Central Counting Station in the Convention and Exhibition Centre took about three hours and 45 minutes using an electronic system.

A total of 5,640 eligible electors voted, for a turnout of 98.79 per cent. Results for the 31 contested subsectors, in which 856 candidates competed for 723 seats, have been published on the official elections website.

Electoral Affairs Commission chairman David Lok said the voting and counting processes were smooth and reflected the principles of openness, honesty and fairness. He said the commission was satisfied with the overall arrangements.

Chief Executive John Lee congratulated all the winners. He said the polls represented healthy competition among patriots who are committed, competent and constructive, and highlighted the positivity of democratic development under the principle of patriots administering Hong Kong. He expressed the expectation that members would fulfil their duties diligently and contribute to the steady implementation of one country, two systems.

Notable outcomes included the election of former justice secretary Rimsky Yuen in the legal subsector and former Legislative Council president Andrew Leung in the industrial first subsector. Reports indicated that the Law Society president was not among those elected in the legal subsector.

zh.headline: 選委會點票順利完成 結果已公布 投票率達98.79%
zh.dek: 選舉管理委員會表示，點票工作於周日晚上10時15分完成；行政長官李家超恭賀所有當選人。
body: 選舉管理委員會表示，選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉的點票工作於周日晚上10時15分順利完成。投票於下午6時結束，票箱運抵會展中央點票站後隨即展開點票，使用電子點票系統，約時三小時45分鐘。
共有5,640名合資格投票人投票，累積投票率為98.79%。31個須競逐的界別分組中，856名候選人競逐723席，結果已於選舉網站公布。
選管會主席陸啟康法官表示，投票及點票過程順利，體現公開、誠實和公平的原則。他指選管會滿意整體安排。
行政長官李家超恭賀所有當選人。他說，是次選舉充分展現愛國者之間健康競爭，影顯「愛國者治港」原則下民主發展的正面性。他期望選委會委員盡責履職，為穩健實施「一國兩制」作出貢獻。
值得注意的結果包括前法務局局長袁國強在法律界當選，以及前立法會主席梁君彥在工業界（第一）當選。報道指，律師會會長未能在法律界當選。
